text.en:
Paragraph (iii) (1), Sec. 178 of the 1978 Election Code amended. Paragraph (iii) (1), Sec. 178 of
the 1978 Election Code is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(iii) (1) Any person who sells, furnishes, offers or takes intoxicating liquor on the days fixed by law for
registration of voters in the voting centers, or on any of the two days immediately preceding election day, or
on election day. HOTELS AND OTHER ESTABLISHMENTS DULY ACCREDITED BY THE
DEPARTMENT OF TOURISM AS TOURIST-ORIENTED AND HABITUALLY IN THE BUSINESS OF
CATERING TO FOREIGN TOURIST MAY, HOWEVER, BE EXEMPTED FOR JUSTIFIABLE
REASONS FROM THE PROVISIONS OF THIS PARAGRAPH UPON PRIOR AUTHORITY OF THE
COMMISSION."

Effectivity. This decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 4th day of April, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
